description:
Plan the full visual storyboard: segments, shot pacing, image/video
    prompts, overlays, continuation chains — driven by the channel's director
    and art styles. Requires voiceover to exist (timing comes from it).
    Plans generated stills + real media only (real media requires the style's
    @real-media tag); generated video is added per segment after the images
    render, with animate_segment.
    Async — returns {job_id}; this is the longest LLM step.

editable_sections.description: Per-call prompt section overrides, keyed by section name; see get_section_template("storyboard")
editable_sections.title: Editable Sections

model.description: Model ID to plan with; empty uses the default (see list_models("storyboard"))
model.title: Model

project_id.description: Project ID, as returned by create_project or list_projects
project_id.title: Project Id

settings.description: Model-specific settings; valid keys come from the model's settings_schema in list_models("storyboard")
settings.title: Settings
